marketplace.summary: Designs claim-locked cell and animal validation routes from computational or association findings, with defined experimental units, randomization, blinding, controls, and escalation gates, without inventing models, effect sizes, or ethics approvals.

skills.name: mechanism-to-validation-planner
skills.description: Turns an association or mechanism finding into a staged validation ladder that separates replication, perturbation, specificity, robustness, and clinical relevance.

skills.name: animal-and-cell-validation-planner
skills.description: Plans claim-centered cell and animal validation with model choice, perturbations, controls, readouts, go/no-go gates, and Lite to Publication+ workload tiers.

skills.name: translational-study-blueprint
skills.description: Frames one primary translational use case with an evidence ladder, milestone thresholds, non-advancement signals, and feasibility-aware fallback routes.

skills.name: experiment-design
skills.description: Guides design selection, control types, randomization and blinding schemes, bias mitigation, and protocol structure for comparative experiments.

skills.name: sample-size-basic
skills.description: Computes per-group and total N for two-group mean, proportion, or survival comparisons from alpha, power, and effect size, with an assumptions summary.

skills.name: randomization-gen
skills.description: Generates blocked randomization lists across named groups and exports them as CSV for concealed allocation of subjects or animals.

skills.name: sop-writer
skills.description: Drafts a structured standard operating procedure with purpose, scope, responsibilities, procedure steps, quality control, documentation, and approval sections.

skills.name: methodology-extractor
skills.description: Extracts and compares experimental methods across papers into protocol-oriented tables of steps, parameters, and cross-study variations.
